name: notenest
description: A modern, responsive, and robust full-stack note-taking application. NoteNest allows users to seamlessly create, read, update, and delete notes with a clean UI and secure backend API.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix backend

author: Muhammad Nassar
